## Symbols {#symbols .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

The following symbols are used to mark safety relevant information:

 

  Symbol                                                                                                             Meaning
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ![Danger_cropped](danger_cropped.png){style="margin:0 auto 0 auto;width:2.0833in;height:0.2188in;border:none"}     Identifies a dangerous situation that will result in death or serious injury if it is not avoided.
  ![Warning_cropped](warning_cropped.png){style="margin:0 auto 0 auto;width:2.0833in;height:0.2292in;border:none"}   Identifies a dangerous situation that may result in death or serious injury if it is not avoided.
  ![Caution_cropped](caution_cropped.png){style="margin:0 auto 0 auto;width:2.0833in;height:0.2292in;border:none"}   Identifies a dangerous situation that may result in minor to moderate injury if it is not avoided.
  ![Notice_cropped](notice_cropped.png){style="margin:0 auto 0 auto;width:2.0833in;height:0.2292in;border:none"}     Property damage: The product or surrounding area may be damaged.

[]{#fig_f86185 .hmanchor}Table2: Hazard classes as defined in ANSI Z535.6.

Additionally, the following symbols mark important \"non-safety\" aspects (e.g., security, SW, \...):\
 

  Symbol                                                                                     Meaning
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ----------------------------------------------------------
  ![Attention](attention.png){style="margin:0;width:2.1667in;height:0.7083in;border:none"}   Identifies a major issue the user needs to take care of.
  ![Info](info.png){style="margin:0;width:2.1667in;height:0.6979in;border:none"}             Identifies a minor issue the user needs to take care of.

[]{#fig_6a2828 .hmanchor}Table3: Additional \'non-safety\' symbols.
